blockerCodes.MCP_UNREACHABLE: UnrealMCP port 55557 not reachable — open Editor and verify MCP green dot
blockerCodes.CONFIG_MISSING: Required repo file or JSON config missing
blockerCodes.CONFIG_EMPTY_PATH: Character config path is empty — assign skeletal_mesh (anim_blueprint may be empty only for legacy VP-B mesh-only interim)
blockerCodes.REPO_SCRIPT_MISSING: Bootstrap or placement script missing from repo
blockerCodes.ASSET_MISSING_ON_DISK: Required .uasset/.umap not found under Content/ (LFS or local import)
blockerCodes.EDITOR_RESULTS_MISSING: Editor deep-check results missing — run preflight_ue_editor.py via MCP on DESKTOP
blockerCodes.EDITOR_ABP_SKELETON: ABP skeleton missing or AnimBP failed to compile (checks config anim_blueprint / characterAnimBlueprint)
blockerCodes.EDITOR_BP_MESH_EMPTY: BP_HomeWorldCharacter skeletal mesh or anim_class unset/broken
blockerCodes.EDITOR_MAP_MISSING: VS_MVP map asset missing or unloadable in Editor
